Name: DustyNPC
Author: Endwyr
Description:
Essentially follows Alex around to most locations, but some evenings goes off exploring on his own. Dusty has a 1 Heart Cutscene in the Forest on Sunny days. You can also talk to him at his Doghouse if you wish.

Newly Released:
==Unsquished Dusty==
There are 2 files to download. (1) DustyNPC, this is the mod. (2) DustyOneTileWide, this is what makes him to be Unsquished, and to have normal pathing. Without the second, his pathfinding will be all kinds of bugged.

== FAQ ==
Does Dusty care if I dig in the trash?
He's curious, but he doesn't care (no friendship points lost).

Why does he talk?
He has a 1 Heart event in the Forest on Sunny days where he will explain.

Why is he not at Festivals?
This is a long-term fix that I will get out at some point. His current sprite gets cut in half at festivals, so will not work at this time.

== Likes/Dislikes ==
Loves
Meat, Cooking, Chewing Stick, Driftwood

Likes
Monster Loot, Both Lucky Purple Shorts, Soggy Newspaper, Wood, Hardwood,

Dislikes & Hates
Seeds, Greens, Grapes, Bone Fragments, Radioactive Things, Any Cakes, Pies, Cookies, Sweets, anything that is toxic to dogs, and anything with Sugar

== Compatibility ==
Is it compatible with DustyMod2ElectricBoogaloo?
I have not tested mod compatibility, but feel free to comment if you find out.
Any mods that edit Dusty's pen are likely incompatible (see the image of Dusty's pen for specific tiles).
